normal.name: Retro Dream
normal.text: Their Finest Hour: The Battle of Britain (1989), a Lucasfilm Games hit on DOS PC. Its secret? Beautiful 2D aircraft sprites creating the illusion of 3D, combined with polygonal terrain. Add dynamic campaigns, mission editing and video replays. A remarkable technical achievement
